verdict.rationale: The docs say skills "build on the open agent skills standard" and define a skill as a directory with a `SKILL.md` carrying `name` and `description` frontmatter, discovered from the vendor-neutral `.agents/skills` path. A hands-on probe used third-party `npx skills` tooling to install a catalog skill as a plain folder with valid frontmatter, showing the format is not Codex-locked. Missing for 10: hands-on proof that the same skill folder runs in a non-OpenAI agent (the probe targeted Codex), and explicit documentation of spec version or field-level conformance ("builds on" leaves possible extensions unclear).
